claim_en: THE EIGHTH OF THE COUNT. Eighth to the consecration (the Sinai third-day analogy), landing on 1 Nisan; the Presence rested on Aaron's service; va-yehi = creation-day joy.
THE CALF ANSWERS THE CALF. The species-to-offense atonement map (ox for the ox-deed, calf for the calf-deed); the fear-slaughtered consolation; alacrity and standing joy.
APPROACH, AND OWN-BEFORE-PEOPLE. The altar-as-ox fear recorded; his own offering first; his atones for him and the people, theirs not for priests.

source: Sifra, Shemini, Mechilta d'Miluim 2 9 + Onkelos Lev 9:15
claim_en: LIKE THE FIRST. The ka-rishon import of the application pattern; Onkelos decodes the verb as atoned-with-its-blood.

source: Sifra, Shemini, Mechilta d'Miluim 2 10 + Onkelos Lev 9:16
claim_en: KA-MISHPAT THE PROCEDURE POINTER. One word imports the Lev-1 olah table (flay, cut, wholly, stand-and-throw, returned limbs); Onkelos: as-is-fitting.
THE FISTFUL SYNC. Milui-milui to Lev 2:2 (pebble/salt/frankincense-crumb disqualify); two meal offerings that day.
COMMUNAL SHELAMIM FROM HERE. The people's ox-and-ram seats the class; the seven services learned in an hour.
THE TRANSPOSED BLESSING. 9:22 recorded as a transposed verse; the palms-lifting earned forever; standing derived by the service pairing; the text sealed here, opened at Num 6:24-26.
THE JOINT ENTRY AND THE FIRE. The incense/blessing arms; Aaron's distress and the joint prayer; the fire answered by song; Onkelos's glory-revealed policy.
